title: Lambda Calculus Verification Checklist
description: Walk through a table-driven test harness that parses and reduces lambda calculus test cases.
source: draft: agy free model + edit: codex

steps.description: Start with the assert_equal_by_alpha(t1, t2, msg) stub for comparing two lambda terms up to variable renaming.
Define tests as a list of (description, term_str, expected_int_or_none) tuples covering identity, constant functions, and Church numerals.
Loop through tests: when term_str is present, call parse_lc(term_str) and reduce_normal(term); otherwise print a code test placeholder, catching any exceptions.

steps.question: What happens when this verification loop runs on its own without parse_lc and reduce_normal imported?
steps.answer: Calling parse_lc(term_str) on line 26 raises NameError. The except block catches it and prints FAIL for the five string-based test cases. The three None entries take the else branch on line 30.

steps.description: See the try/except block catch the missing parse_lc definition and report the failure cleanly without crashing the test loop.
